answer: Before a falcon is trusted to hunt free, its handler keeps it tethered to a low ledge and watches every flight. New agents can be treated the same way: each fresh identity posts a small refundable bond, and its first earnings stay escrowed for several epochs while randomly chosen peers audit its work. A sybil operator must fund every bond up front and keep each puppet producing genuine output during that wait, so a sable flock of fakes costs real money, and one caught cheat forfeits its stake.
